entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I need to make a return? I have this helmet and I'm just not sure what to do. I'm a bit overwhelmed.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your account, could I please get your order number?
Oh, sure, hold on. It's... VF00... 6... 7... 4... 3... 2... 1. Is that right? I get these numbers mixed up.
Got it, thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Aero Road Helmet, delivered on December 21st. Is that the correct item?

Yes, that's the one. It's just... the color isn't what I expected. I haven't even taken it out, the box is unopened. I was also worried about safety after reading something online. I just... Can't you just help me? The website is so confusing.
Of course, I can absolutely help. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see you've had the helmet for 22 days.
Oh, has it been that long? I'm so sorry, I wasn't sure what the rule was.
No need to worry at all. For this item, our return policy is 90 days from the date of delivery. So you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you. I was so worried I had missed the deadline.

Not at all. I am processing the return for you now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You can just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any UPS location.
Wow, okay. That's so much easier than I thought. Thank you so much, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. You've been a great help.
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
